category: hosted developer secrets management, end-to-end encrypted vault with a web app, CLI and REST API

free_tier.stated: Free subscription: unlimited secret storage with up to 2 users, up to 3 projects, and up to 3 machine accounts; a free 14-day trial is offered for the paid tiers
free_tier.notes: The headline quantity is unlimited secret storage. The free offer also caps users at 2, projects at 3 and machine accounts at 3. Paid Teams and Enterprise include up to 20 and 50 machine accounts and charge USD 1 for each additional machine account.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-secret size limit is stated on the first-party pages read

retention.stated: stored secrets have no stated automatic expiry; on deletion a secret moves to Trash for 30 days and is then permanently deleted and cannot be recovered
retention.notes: The 30-day figure is the post-deletion Trash window, not an automatic lifetime for stored secrets. Event logs on paid tiers are retained indefinitely with a 367-day viewing window.

egress.terms: not a byte-transfer service: a secrets vault reached through the web app, the bws CLI and a REST API; the Public API returns 429 Too Many Requests when hit too quickly and the CLI warns that many sessions from one IP in a short span may hit rate limits. No per-GB egress charge is stated.

interface_detail: A REST Public API compatible with OpenAPI Specification 3 with a published swagger.json, at https://api.bitwarden.com or https://api.bitwarden.eu for cloud, authenticating with OAuth2 client credentials bearer tokens. The bws CLI reads and writes secrets through machine-account access tokens and injects them as environment variables. The SDK has a Rust core with C++, C#, Go, Java, JS, PHP, Python and Ruby wrappers. A web vault exists for setup, but programmatic access is through the REST API and CLI.
tooling: The bws CLI, installed with curl https://bws.bitwarden.com/install | sh or run as the ghcr.io/bitwarden/bws Docker image, the Bitwarden SDK wrappers (Python, Java, Go, C#, JS, PHP, Ruby, C++, Rust) and the Public REST API
chaining: Store CI/CD and application credentials in an end-to-end encrypted hosted vault and inject them at runtime through the bws CLI or an SDK using scoped machine-account access tokens.

limits.value: up to 3 machine accounts on Free, USD 1 per additional machine account on paid tiers
many separate access-token sessions from the same IP address in a short span of time may encounter rate limits
Public API returns 429 Too Many Requests when hit too quickly; no numeric rate is stated

limits_note: Each secret belongs to a single project at a time, and a machine account sees only secrets in projects it can access.
binding_note: Secret storage is unlimited, so the free-tier count ceilings of 3 machine accounts, 3 projects and 2 users bind before any storage quantity.

identity_cost.detail: Email and a master password: the account page says 'Enter your Email address and choose your preferred server location', then 'Bitwarden will email you a verification link', and the free-account page states 'No credit card required!'. No phone number, ID document or institution is asked. Secrets Manager is then enabled inside an organization, and only owners can add it.

reliability_note: An access token appears once at creation and cannot be retrieved later. The Public API returns 429 when hit too quickly and CLI sessions sharing an IP in a short span may be rate limited. No data loss or ban is stated on the pages read.
confidence_note: All values are quoted from first-party pricing, help and signup pages captured on 2026-11-19. No probe was run, so the read path is documented rather than measured. The per-secret size cap is unverified and no account was opened.
